bitcoin_articles.headline: Siebert Financial Analyst Reaffirms Buy Rating on MicroStrategy
bitcoin_articles.summary: Siebert Financial analyst Brian Vieten reaffirmed a Buy rating and $350 price target on MicroStrategy (MSTR) shares, projecting the company could hold approximately 1.04 million Bitcoin by the third quarter of 2027.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, highlighting significant growth in its Bitcoin treasury.
